how_to_use: This index provides a fast lookup directory of all symbols defined within the target file. Agents can use the 'line_range' attribute to target and view individual sections instead of loading the entire file.

actions.name: DynamicRepository
actions.goal: Act as a schema-driven Active Record manager for a specific entity.
actions.description:
Provides a high-level, fluent CRUD interface for dynamic model entities.
Hydrates raw rows from TableGateway into BaseModel instances, enforcing validations and relationship constraints.

actions.name: constructor
actions.description:
Binds the target entity table name, TableGateway I/O driver, SchemaRegistry, and RelationResolver.
Ensures all active record query and relation mappings have access to necessary database subsystems.

actions.name: _hydrate
actions.goal: Internal helper to convert raw data into a BaseModel instance.
actions.description:
Converts raw spreadsheet arrays/objects into smart, validated BaseModel instances.
Restores context-level bindings to enable active record methods (like save() and remove()) on individual row results.

actions.name: all
actions.goal: Fetches all records from the table.
actions.description:
Retrieves every physical row in the table collection.
Hydrates all records into model instances; useful for complete scans, catalog loading, or caching.

actions.name: findById
actions.goal: Finds a single record by its primary key.
actions.description:
Queries and hydrates a single record using its primary identifier.
Use this for direct, key-based lookup when the key is known (highly optimized O(1) cache matching).

actions.name: isTableExist
actions.goal: Checks if the table physically exists in the database.
actions.description:
Verifies if the corresponding spreadsheet sheet has been provisioned.
Use to prevent runtime errors prior to loading data from uninitialized tables.

actions.name: exists
actions.goal: Checks if any record matches the filters.
actions.description:
Verifies the existence of records matching custom filters without loading rows into memory.
Optimized to check counts directly rather than hydrating model lists.

actions.name: findOne
actions.goal: Finds the first record matching the filters.
actions.description:
Queries the database and returns the first matching hydrated record.
Use when you expect a single result or only need to verify/fetch a single representative instance.

actions.name: count
actions.description:
Returns the size/count of rows matching target criteria.
Use to get row statistics or check size bounds without loading payloads.

actions.name: where
actions.goal: Filters records based on simple equality.
actions.description:
Retrieves a list of hydrated model instances matching the provided key-value filters.
Use to query specific segments of table data (e.g., student enrollments by package ID).

actions.name: insert
actions.goal: Inserts a new record into the database.
actions.description:
Persists a new row payload or saves an existing BaseModel instance.
Use to create individual records; handles model schema validation and ID allocation.

actions.name: insertOne
actions.goal: MongoDB Style: Inserts a record and all its nested relations.
actions.description:
Recursively processes and inserts a document with nested child relationships.
Handles parent primary key generation and injects it as foreign keys on child tables automatically.

actions.name: insertMany
actions.goal: Performs an optimized, prioritized batch insert for multiple nested documents.
actions.description:
Leverages a BatchBucket to group and sequence writes across multiple tables in memory.
Minimizes Apps Script sheet I/O operations by writing bulk matrices in a single call.

actions.name: update
actions.goal: Updates an existing record by its primary key.
actions.description:
Merges new updates with an existing record and saves the result.
Ensures validations are executed on the fully merged state before writing to the database.

actions.name: enforceDeleteConstraints
actions.goal: Enforces relational database constraints (protect, cascade, set_null) on deletion.
actions.description:
Inspects the dynamic schema dependency graph for active references before deleting a parent record.
Evicts cascaded records or nulls foreign key cells to guarantee database referential integrity.

actions.name: remove
actions.goal: Deletes a record by its primary key.
actions.description:
Evaluates delete constraint policies and physically evicts the row from the spreadsheet.
Use to delete a single parent record cleanly with all its child constraints enforced.

actions.name: enforceDeleteConstraintsBatch
actions.goal: Enforces batch relational database constraints (protect, cascade, set_null) on deletion.
actions.description:
Implements a memory-optimized Surgical Graph Rollback strategy for batch deletions.
Pre-loads descendant tables in a single pass to check constraints in memory, rolling back if dry-run validation fails.

actions.name: deleteMany
actions.goal: Deletes multiple records by their primary keys.
actions.description:
Deletes a set of parent records and propagates cascading evictions/updates in bulk.
Minimizes roundtrips by using batch constraint validations and batch spreadsheet row deletions.

actions.name: updateMany
actions.goal: Batch update multiple records and return hydrated models.
actions.description:
Updates multiple records using a mapping of IDs to changes in a single operation.
Optimizes performance by batch-updating values and returning hydrated instances.
